decisions.rationale: The concatenation and repetition come from the shared derivation tool (tools/qa/md-from-html.mjs), so the fix is a separate repository tooling PR (pep-b13-md-derivation): keep list and table cell separation and Markdown structure, and emit the recap, cheat sheet and sources once. After it lands, regenerate all five artifact.md files and the Reading PDF with the tool. Do not hand-edit derived Markdown.

Replace the pending-plan boilerplate in all five topic lab reasons with the final rationale: embedded practice covers these topic objectives, F1 has no required lab, and the approved course-level 'Ship a safe change' lab is planned for course assembly.

Recorded post-import correctness edit: say that a pipe sends standard output (stdout) to the next command's standard input (stdin), and note that stderr is separate unless redirected (|& or 2>&1). Apply it in the page teaching, recap and cheat sheet, and let the derived Markdown follow. Record it in content-changes evidence for the recheck.

Replace the man7.org mirror citations with current gnu.org Bash, grep and Coreutils manual URLs, live-fetched with retrieval timestamps and sha256, in all four sources.json files and the learner source disclosures.
Recorded post-import edit: teach and display echo "$NAME" (or printf '%s\n' "$NAME") in teaching, recap, cheat sheet and completion guidance. The simulator's accepted command set may stay.
Give each video.json receipt an explicit repo-relative reviewedPath naming its topic's video-artifact.md, regenerate module.lock.json, and verify all five video bindings resolve as current.
